meta.protocol: seeded Math.random + seeded crypto.getRandomValues + deterministic 16.667 ms rAF stepping; demo frames every 100 ms over 60 s

thresholdCompare.note: Same 600 frames/version, only the lit-pixel threshold changed. maxRGB>4 is "any non-black pixel" (demo background is exactly 0,0,0).
thresholdCompare.interpretation: Threshold >4 leaves the minRatio unchanged, so the sub-0.9 frames are not dark pixels being filtered. They are all within 2.5 s of a turn start (t=3,8,...): the engine grows extent fast (lambda 14) but shrinks it slowly (lambda 2.5), so during the post-turn silhouette change the probe is larger than the current body for a moment. On stable poses both versions are >=0.9. This is a measurement window, not missing geometry: culling on/off renders are identical and >4 finds no extra pixels.

cullOnOff.note: Separate pass over the same deterministic 60 s timeline: each frame rendered twice (uCull=1 and uCull=0). 0.9.29 and 0.9.30 both reported 0 px bbox deficit and 0 lit-pixel delta on every frame, so the old hard-coded 2.1 sphere did not delete visible geometry in this timeline.

task2.pose: place(center, depth 0) + face(90); 8 frames at 0.5 s intervals

aggregate.note: paired old/new ratio from the earlier full-image pass is not comparable; use the ring mean/P95 values (same fixed pixel ring).
